verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents automatic security scans through an out-of-the-box Snyk integration installed from the repository's Security tab, and it can show third-party code reports in pull requests. The scanning itself is done by a third-party provider rather than native Bitbucket scanning, and the docs give no detail on what is covered. Missing for 10: native first-party scanning, explicit documentation of dependency-vulnerability versus code (SAST) scanning coverage, depth of scan-result workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
